title: Telemetry stack Terraform module — durable upgrades & active-prober bundle (VPC)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Create a single opinionated Terraform module that provisions the full observability stack inside customer VPCs (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry Collector, and log shipping agents). The module should prioritize safe, non-disruptive upgrades for on-prem and VPC deployments and include an active prober subsystem to validate availability and data flow after changes. Target consumers: Private install automation (VPC + on-prem), Redwood Private control plane, and Dedicated onboarding tooling.

Scope:
- Terraform module that provisions k8s manifests (Helm or kustomize) and cloud infra glue (IAM roles, S3/Cloud Storage buckets for logs, KMS keys).
- Upgrade strategies: blue/green or canary chart rollouts, pre-upgrade snapshot/export of Prometheus TSDB metadata, KV reconciliation for OTEL config, semantic version locking for Helm charts.
- Health checks & probers: HTTP/GRPC probes for Grafana/OTel/Prometheus, ingestion checks that validate metrics and traces make it to backend (test metrics, test trace spans), and a reconciliation job that alerts on schema drift.
- Observability of the observability stack: expose internal dashboards and synthetic-traffic-based SLOs to the Redwood Console.
- Security: enforce least-privilege IAM, envelope encryption for log storage, optional customer-managed KMS/HSM integration.

Non-goals: Building a custom metrics backend — we rely on Prometheus/Grafana + existing log storage. No work on multi-tenant single-cluster observability in this ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module accepts variables for VPC IDs, cluster identifiers, and KMS keys and provisions resources deterministically
Module supports a staged upgrade: canary rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) of Helm charts with automated rollback on health-check regression
Active prober job runs post-deploy and validates at least one sample metric, one trace, and one log event are ingested within 60s
Prometheus TSDB snapshot/export created before major version upgrades and restoration tested in a dry-run cluster
Security review completed and IAM/KMS flows documented in design spec
E2E smoke test added to infra CI that deploys the module to a sandbox VPC and exercises the prober
tasks: Draft module public interface (variables/outputs) and wireframes for default dashboards
Implement Helm chart wrapper and HelmRelease resource templates
Add upgrade orchestration: chart version pinning, pre-hooks for snapshot, post-hooks for probes
Build active prober: k8s CronJob that emits test metric/trace/log and validates ingestion
Create Terraform acceptance tests (Terratest or kitchen-terraform) that assert canary rollout behavior
Document runbooks for manual rollback and disaster recovery
Coordinate with Security for KMS integration and least-privilege IAM roles
Add integration to Redwood Console (route + dashboard link + health API)
